stemMd: A population of bacteria acquires a plasmid carrying a resistance gene from another bacterial population. Which process best describes this genetic change?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Conversion of the plasmid into a ribosome

options.label: E
options.textMd: Independent assortment of homologous chromosome pairs

explanationMd: Genetic material has moved between organisms outside parent-to-offspring inheritance. That is horizontal gene transfer. A plasmid can transfer genes between bacterial cells, although the precise route—such as conjugation—cannot be determined from the information given.

distractorRationale.b: Bacteria do not acquire plasmids through meiotic division.
distractorRationale.c: The event concerns transfer between bacteria, not embryogenesis.
distractorRationale.e: That mechanism belongs to meiosis in eukaryotes.
distractorRationale.a: Plasmids are DNA elements, not ribosomal particles.
